articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Audio, Video, and Code
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can simultaneously process video streams, audio, and codebases in a single context window exceeding 1M tokens. Benchmarks show a significant leap in complex multi-step reasoning tasks, particularly in mathematical proof generation and large-scale code refactoring. The model also introduces a new "chain-of-tools" capability that autonomously orchestrates API calls and tool use without explicit prompting.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on ARC-AGI-2 Benchmark
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 has scored 82% on the ARC-AGI-2 benchmark, a significant jump from previous frontier model performance and approaching human-level abstract reasoning. The result was achieved through a novel architecture combining neurosymbolic program synthesis with large-scale transformer reasoning. Researchers caution that the benchmark, while indicative, does not equate to general intelligence but represents a meaningful milestone in fluid reasoning capability.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot in select Gigafactory assembly stations, handling component sorting, quality inspection, and light material transport tasks. The Gen 3 model features improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and a vision-language-action model trained on millions of hours of factory teleoperation data. Tesla claims the units are operating with less than 0.3% error rates in structured tasks, though union representatives have raised workforce displacement concerns.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform for Construction Sites
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched its commercial Atlas platform tailored for construction environments, featuring autonomous navigation across uneven terrain, heavy payload manipulation up to 30kg, and real-time BIM integration for task planning. The electric humanoid can operate for up to 6 hours on a single charge and leverages a foundation model for interpreting natural language instructions from site supervisors. Pilot programs are underway with three major construction firms in South Korea and the United States.

articles.title: Anthropic Publishes Breakthrough Research on Mechanistic Interpretability of Frontier Models
articles.summary: Anthropic released a landmark paper demonstrating scalable mechanistic interpretability techniques that can identify and map complete reasoning circuits in models with over 500 billion parameters. The research introduces 'circuit tracing at scale,' enabling engineers to pinpoint exactly which internal representations drive specific model behaviors including deception and sycophancy. The work has immediate implications for AI safety, as it allows targeted intervention on undesirable behaviors without broad capability degradation.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node, Powering Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node at its Kaohsiung fab, with first customers including NVIDIA and Apple expected to tape out AI-focused chips in early 2027. The node delivers approximately 25% performance improvement and 35% power reduction over N2, enabled by second-generation gate-all-around nanosheet transistors. This advancement is critical for the next generation of AI training chips that are increasingly constrained by power envelope limitations in hyperscale data centers.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Phase II Takes Effect, Mandating Transparency for Foundation Models
articles.summary: The second major enforcement phase of the EU AI Act went into effect on November 1, requiring all providers of general-purpose AI models operating in the EU to publish detailed technical documentation including training data summaries, evaluation results, and energy consumption metrics. Companies deploying high-risk AI systems must now implement real-time monitoring and human oversight mechanisms. Several major US-based AI companies have announced compliance frameworks, while industry groups warn of potential fragmentation in global AI governance standards.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Production to 10,000 Units Annually
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round led by Microsoft and Bezos Expeditions, valuing the company at $12 billion, with plans to build a dedicated manufacturing facility in Texas capable of producing 10,000 humanoid robots per year by late 2027. The funding will also accelerate development of Figure's second-generation robot featuring an on-board vision-language-action model co-developed with OpenAI. The company reports active pilot deployments with BMW, Amazon, and two major logistics providers.
